system.description:
Seneschal is the ability to administer holdings, from households to kingdoms. It covers knowledge of physical assets and their needs — harvesting crops, maintaining buildings, managing taxes — along with the social skill to coordinate others' labor and resolve disputes.

A skilled seneschal can also evaluate the state of another's holdings from personal experience and theoretical knowledge, making the Ability invaluable to those who wield or serve worldly power.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
